arxiv-2011-12336.title: Aerodynamic characterization of low-aspect-ratio swept wings at R ​ e = 400 Re=400
arxiv-2011-12336.creator: Kai Zhang \aff 1 \corresp, Kunihiko Taira \aff 1
arxiv-2011-12336.description: Abstract 1 Introduction The low-Reynolds-number aerodynamics have been extensively studied over the past few decades due the interests in designing small-scale air vehicles and understanding biological flights. At these scales, flows over wings exhibit complex flow physics comprised of unsteady separation, vortex formation, and wake interaction that are different from the high-Reynolds-number counterparts.

arxiv-2304-10797.creator: Yingkun Li, Christina Roehrig
arxiv-2304-10797.description: Abstract . In this paper, we use theta integrals to give a different construction of mock Maass forms studied by Sander Zwegers. With this method, we construct new real-analytic modular forms, whose Fourier coefficients are logarithms of algebraic numbers in a real quadratic field. 1.

arxiv-2309-03114.title: NUV-DOA: NUV Prior-based Bayesian Sparse Reconstruction with Spatial Filtering for Super-Resolution DoA Estimation
arxiv-2309-03114.creator: Mengyuan Zhao, Guy Revach, Tirza Routtenberg, Nir Shlezinger
arxiv-2309-03114.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Mengyuan Zhao, Guy Revach, Tirza Routtenberg, Nir Shlezinger. Achieving high-resolution doa ( doa ) recovery typically requires high snr ( snr ) and a sufficiently large number of snapshots. This paper presents ndoa algorithm, that augments Bayesian sparse reconstruction with spatial filtering for super-resolution doa estimation. By modeling each direction on the azimuth’s grid with the sparsity-promoting nuv prior, the non-convex optimization problem is reduced to iteratively reweighted ls under Gaussian distribution, where the mean of the snapshots is a sufficient statistic.

arxiv-2403-04680.title: Extensive-Form Game Solving via Blackwell Approachability on Treeplexes
arxiv-2403-04680.creator: Darshan Chakrabarti, Julien Grand-Clément, Christian Kroer
arxiv-2403-04680.description: Abstract In this paper, we introduce the first algorithmic framework for Blackwell approachability on the sequence-form polytope, the class of convex polytopes capturing the strategies of players in extensive-form games (EFGs). This leads to a new class of regret-minimization algorithms that are stepsize-invariant, in the same sense as the regret matching and regret matching + algorithms for the simplex.

arxiv-2403-16647.title: Effect of Coriolis Force on Electrical Conductivity Tensor for Rotating Hadron Resonance Gas
arxiv-2403-16647.creator: Nandita Padhan 1 , Ashutosh Dwibedi 2 , Arghya Chatterjee 1 , Sabyasachi Ghosh 2
arxiv-2403-16647.description: Abstract We have investigated the influence of the Coriolis force on the electrical conductivity of hadronic matter formed in relativistic nuclear collisions, employing the Hadron Resonance Gas (HRG) model. A rotating matter in the peripheral heavy ion collisions can be expected from the initial stage of quark matter to late-stage hadronic matter.

arxiv-2405-09003.title: Nonparametric Inference on Dose-Response Curves Without the Positivity Condition
arxiv-2405-09003.creator: Yikun Zhang, Yen-Chi Chen, and Alexander Giessing
arxiv-2405-09003.description: Abstract Existing statistical methods in causal inference often assume the positivity condition, where every individual has some chance of receiving any treatment level regardless of covariates. This assumption could be violated in observational studies with continuous treatments. arxiv-2406-04667.title: Prescribed mean curvature flow for noncompact hypersurfaces in Lorentz manifolds
arxiv-2406-04667.creator: Luen-Fai Tam
arxiv-2406-04667.description: Abstract . Motivated by previous study on mean curvature flow and prescribed mean curvature flow on spatially compact space or asymptotically flat spacetime, in this work we will find sufficient conditions for the short time existence of prescribed mean curvature flow on a Lorentz manifold with a smooth time function starting from a complete noncompact spacelike hypersurface.

arxiv-2602-11209.title: SAFuzz: Semantic-Guided Adaptive Fuzzing for LLM-Generated Code
arxiv-2602-11209.creator: Ziyi Yang, Kalit Inani, Keshav Kabra, Vima Gupta, Anand Padmanabha Iyer
arxiv-2602-11209.description: Abstract While AI-coding assistants accelerate software development, current testing frameworks struggle to keep pace with the resulting volume of AI-generated code. Traditional fuzzing techniques often allocate resources uniformly and lack semantic awareness of algorithmic vulnerability patterns, leading to inefficient resource usage and missed vulnerabilities.

pmc-10668009.creator: Yuchen Xu, Hubin Zhao, Cosimo Ieracitano
pmc-10668009.description: of brain-computer interfaces (BCI) and neurofeedback (NF) technologies shines as a promising beacon of transformation. The concept of a closed-loop brain interface refers to the seamless integration of neural recording, decoding, and stimulation. This harmonious integration aims not only to bridge gaps, but also to foster collaboration among diverse scientific disciplines.

pmc-11514068.title: Triple combination of vemurafenib, cobimetinib, and atezolizumab in real clinical practice in the Russian Federation: results of the A1 cohort of the ISABELLA study
pmc-11514068.creator: Igor V. Samoylenko, Yulia M. Kolontareva, Ekaterina V. Kogay, Natalia V. Zhukova, Igor A. Utyashev, Mikhail E. Ivannikov, Konstantin V. Menshikov, Maxim V. Zinkevich, Kristina V. Orlova, Yulia V. Vakhabova, Mikhail V. Volkonsky, Natalia A. Beliaeva, Ivan I. Butkov, Elena V. Karabina, Tatyana L. Mosk
pmc-11514068.description: BackgroundAmong several treatment options for BRAF-mutant metastatic melanoma, a combination of BRAF inhibitor, MEK inhibitor, and anti-PDL1 antibody seems to be a new emergent approach recently registered in the Russian Federation. It is still not clear which patient population benefits more from this simultaneous use of three drugs instead of its sequencing.

pmc-11671604.title: Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) With T-Cell Differentiation Arising From Chronic Myelomonocytic Leukemia (CMML)
pmc-11671604.creator: Anthony Crymes, Mark G. Evans, Deepa Jeyakumar, Jerry J. Lou, Xiaohui Zhao, Sherif A. Rezk
pmc-11671604.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Chronic myelomonocytic leukemia (CMML) is a myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm characterized by peripheral blood monocytosis and bone marrow dysplasia. In approximately one-fourth of cases, CMML can demonstrate progression to acute myeloid leukemia (AML), referred to as AML ex CMML. We present a 58-year-old woman with a past medical history of idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura (ITP) who demonstrated 24% bone marrow blasts on a repeat biopsy obtained two years after being diagnosed with CMML.

pmc-12733303.title: QSAR Modeling for Predicting IC50 and GI50 Values for Human Cell Lines Used in Toxicological Studies
pmc-12733303.creator: Alexey A. Lagunin, Elena Y. Lisitsa, Anastasia V. Rudik, Sergey M. Ivanov, Alexander V. Dmitriev, Elena S. Muraviova, Dmitry A. Filimonov, Vladimir V. Poroikov
pmc-12733303.description: Assessing cytotoxicity towards human cells is a critical step in preclinical drug development. In preclinical toxicology, human cell lines allow for the analysis of both general and organ-specific toxicity, thus, helping reduce development time and costs. Predicting cytotoxic IC50 and GI50 values facilitates the early evaluation of new pharmaceutical agents by assessing the possible therapeutic window.

pmc-13146964.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1160 FUNCTIONAL MASSAGE AND ECCENTRIC EXERCISES IN STROKE SURVIVORS. CROSSOVER PILOT RANDOMISED CONTROLLED TRIAL
pmc-13146964.creator: Rosa Cabanas-Valdés, Andrea MacIà-Martí, Carlos López-de-Celis, Pere Rodríguez-Rubio
pmc-13146964.description: Background and aimsOne of the most challenging sequelae after stroke is spasticity-related increased muscle tone, which impairs normal muscle function. The aim of this study is to analyze the effects of functional massage combined with eccentric exercise compared with eccentric exercise alone on lower-limb hypertonia due to spasticity in individuals with chronic stroke.MethodsThis is a crossover study randomized controlled trial.

pmc-13233569.title: Single-cell transcriptomics profiling elucidates RBP-driven metastatic signaling pathways in ER+ breast cancer
pmc-13233569.creator: Mingjie Dong, Xinyu Li, Songyu Yang, Shujuan Li, Zhengzheng Liu, Chuo Peng, Rongyao Li, Weixin Liang, Xia Li, Jing Bai
pmc-13233569.description: SummaryEstrogen receptor-positive breast cancer progression involves extensive cellular remodeling, yet the contribution of RNA-binding proteins to this process remains incompletely defined. Here, we constructed a single-cell transcriptomic atlas of 198,286 cells from 39 samples spanning normal tissue, primary tumors, and metastatic lesions. We identified stage-specific transcriptional and post-transcriptional reprogramming across different cell types.

pmc-13274120.title: Evaluating AI-powered instruction on Computed Tomography Angiography (CTA) teaching outcomes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-13274120.creator: Liang Yuan, Xingyi Xie, Yiqian Wen
pmc-13274120.description: ObjectiveTo systematically evaluate the effectiveness of AI-assisted teaching in computed tomography angiography (CTA) training, focusing on theoretical knowledge, practical skills, image judgment time, and teaching satisfaction.MethodsEight databases were searched for randomized controlled trials (RCTs) from 1990 to 2025. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed risk of bias using the Cochrane RoB 2.0 tool.
